messages:
deploybot: Starting coordinated rollout: release/v2.14.0 (tag: release/v2.14.0, commit: a1b2c3d). Targets: prod US -> prod EU -> prod APAC. Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary: 5% traffic for 15m in each region. Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/releases/v2.14.0 :rocket:

deploybot: Metadata:
```
env: prod
plan: canary(us:5%@15m) -> promote(us) -> canary(eu:5%@15m) -> promote(eu) -> canary(apac:5%@15m)
commit: a1b2c3d
images: inference:v2.14.0
```

sara: On it — dashboards and alerting subscribed. Will watch canary metrics in Grafana.

ben: US canary metrics look clean at 15m. p95 ~190ms, error rate steady. Proceeding to full US rollout now.

deploybot: US rollout: COMPLETE. rollout_status: US=v2.14.0. Next step: starting EU canary.

mike: EU canary early signal — seeing GPU pool eu-1 p99 spike after ~3m. p99 rising to ~650ms (baseline ~220ms). Posting small log snippet:
```
[eu-1] 2026-11-03T02:18:07Z inference: tail latency 650ms kernel_opt=true
[eu-1] 2026-11-03T02:18:09Z serve: qps stable, but eviction rate increased
```

anita: Noted. Recommend pausing EU canary and rolling back EU to previous known good (release/v2.13.4) while we investigate kernel_opt change. APAC should be held.

deploybot: Action: PAUSE EU canary and HOLD APAC rollout per policy (auto-hold on canary anomaly). Initiating EU rollback -> target: release/v2.13.4. Rollback task id: rb-1823456789-1.

sara: I pinned traffic-routing config for eu region to avoid migrating sessions to new pool. Created issue RED-1234 with logs and timeline.

ben: Quick diff shows change in the attention kernel path and kernel_opt toggled on in v2.14.0 build for quantized models. I'll revert that flag and run regression on eu-1.

deploybot: EU rollback status: in-progress. Step: deploy release/v2.13.4 to eu-1 nodes. Estimated time ~4m. APAC rollout remains paused.

mike: Uploading related logs and perf traces to s3: s3://redwood/logs/rollouts/1823456789/eu-1/ — added perf flamegraphs and a core dump.

deploybot: EU rollback COMPLETE. Current region states: US=v2.14.0, EU=v2.13.4 (rolled back), APAC=PAUSED. Summary: rollback due to p99 latency regression on eu-1 caused by kernel_opt change.

anita: Adding note to the release notes: "EU rolled back to v2.13.4 after p99 spike traced to kernel optimization flag. Reintroduce after regression tests and feature gating."

ben: Plan: disable kernel_opt for quantized paths, run the regression suite against eu-1, and schedule a cautious re-canary in EU in 4 hours if green.

sara: Setting expected alert suppressions and rebalancing windows to avoid noisy paging. Documenting timeline in RED-1234.

deploybot: Closing thread. Summary: v2.14.0 -> US successful; EU rolled back to v2.13.4 and APAC rollout paused. Follow-up: postmortem + action items in RED-1234. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/ops/rollouts/1823456789

ben: Thanks — will update when regression results are in. :thumbsup:
